description: Current official hiking-trail closures and detours near a WGS84 point. The search covers roughly radius_km (default 20 km, max 100 km) around the point; it is a map-tolerance buffer that may be a square box, so features up to ~1.4× radius_km away can be included, and distances are not computed. There is no nationwide listing. Use before recommending any hike.
name: get_trail_closures
title: Hiking trail closures near a point
